_documentation.well_known_criterion: Textbook facts and famous results (Higgs discovery, gravitational waves, double-slit).
_documentation.obscure_criterion: Specific experimental apparatus, lesser-cited results, or constants outside common knowledge.
_documentation.post_cutoff_criterion: Major announcements or missions launched after September 2024.
